title: Shifted agreement after one choice
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic multi-tape Turing machine, let $b$ be a choice bit, let $r$ be a natural number, let $d$ assign an integer shift to each work-tape index, and let $c,c'$ be configurations that agree with shift $d$ and radius $r+1$. Then the configurations reached by one step under $b$ from $c$ and $c'$ agree with shift $d$ and radius $r$.
hypotheses_covered: An integer shift $d(i)$ for each work-tape index
